name: jarvis-architect
description: EN: An AI architect that interviews you about your work, decides the right runtime, model, host, channels and tools, then builds your own personal Jarvis with you — locally or on Railway — with security on by default. ES: Un arquitecto de IA que te entrevista sobre tu trabajo, decide el runtime, modelo, hosting, canales y herramientas correctos, y construye contigo tu propio Jarvis — en tu compu o en Railway — con seguridad desde el inicio.
